answer: Resist Sybils with shared-fate cohort dividends. Each epoch, identities are randomly dealt into small cohorts they cannot choose or swap, like a raven assigned to one canyon flock. A cohort's rewards go into one pot split evenly, so extra identities inside your own cohort only dilute your own share. Leaving requires planting a willow: a stranger-verified public task costing real work, whose result stays usable after departure. Since cohorts are random, an attacker cannot cluster fakes to harvest many pots; each new fake mouth eats from the same fixed pot, while honest service grows it.
